summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for AgentOps trace session configuration (task_family: agent_tracing, method_family: trace_configuration) that does not semantically match any existing skill. Existing skills cover data preparation, async result retrieval, and dataset filtering—none address trace session setup. Peer candidates (SDK initialization, session management, tool definition) are in different task families (agent_instrumentation, agent_setup, agent_tooling) and represent complementary but separate capabilities. The candidate has support evidence and no conflicts, warranting creation as a new capability.
